create_ShuffledDatasetAgent: create a ShuffledDatasetAgent that reads a dataset in shuffled order with a given batch size
run_ShuffledDatasetAgent_forward: run the ShuffledDatasetAgent forward method to write a shuffled batch of data to the workspace
seed_ShuffledDatasetAgent: seed the ShuffledDatasetAgent with a random seed for reproducible shuffled dataset sampling
create_DataLoaderAgent: create a DataLoaderAgent that wraps a PyTorch DataLoader to read batches sequentially from a dataset
reset_DataLoaderAgent: reset the DataLoaderAgent iterator and finished flag to restart reading from the beginning of the dataset
